admission.justification: The rule spans the admitted cleanup and abandon transactions and the archive service, which together archive before removal.

applicability: Admitted leaf and modern series (worktrees/) finalize, cleanup, abandon, and completed-generation retries.
conditions: Leaf contracts select recorded leaf role agents matching their canonical task reference and lifecycle generation; modern series contracts select recorded seats whose workspace lies inside worktree_group.
Dry run passes dry_run=True to inspect seats and owed targets without mutating host or receipt state.
exclusions: Legacy series whose worktree_group equals enclosures/ and sprint archival do not invoke seat archival.
Seats whose workspace lies outside the task folder (such as a master's Manager) do not block series folder removal.

statement: Admitted leaf and modern series finalize, cleanup, and abandon invoke host archival for the exact recorded in-group role agents before removing worktrees and the task folder, while dry run inspects seats without archiving.
title: Admitted leaf and modern series retirements archive seats before removal
